preconditions: A source-linked contiguous observed depth log
A measured route with an explicitly calculated borehole station
Absolute collar-elevation authority is evaluated separately
decisionLogic: Render only a narrow depth-log column at its station; all surrounding subsurface remains Unknown
uncertainty: An unverified collar elevation is labelled as reported and cannot authorize a section contact
exclusions: No contact correlation away from the hole
No inference from terrain or aerial imagery
validationMethod: Positive rendering plus out-of-route and authorization-promotion rejection tests
reopenCondition: Multiple correlation controls or independently authorized structural geometry becomes available
